long.title: Cairo Chillhop 🚆
long.summary: Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride along the Nile through an illustrated Cairo at a warm golden sunset: the Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx glowing beyond palm groves, white-sailed feluccas on the river, the Cairo Tower and domed mosques with slender minarets, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

short_1.title: Cairo Chillhop 🚆 #lofi #cairo #shorts
short_1.summary: The Pyramids of Giza glowing gold over the Nile at sunset, then a ride past palm groves and mud-brick houses along the river, with mellow lofi beats.
